package.json.description: Root monorepo configuration with SST dependency and workspaces definition for packages/*

sst.config.ts.description: SST infrastructure configuration that orchestrates deployment to dev/prod stages with AWS account validation and instantiates storage, API, and web app components

packages/infrastructure/package.json.description: Infrastructure package with AWS SDK dependencies and production deployment script

packages/infrastructure/components/stora.description: Creates a DynamoDB table named "Todos" for storing todo list data indexed by ID

packages/infrastructure/components/api.t.description: Creates API Gateway V2 with PUT and GET endpoints for todo list operations linked to the Todos table

packages/infrastructure/components/webAp.description: Creates a static site deployment on S3/CloudFront for the web app built from packages/web-app with Bun

packages/api/package.json.description: Dependencies for API Lambda handlers including AWS SDK 2, SST framework, and TypeScript types for AWS Lambda.

packages/api/tsconfig.json.description: TypeScript compiler configuration for Node.js 20 with ES2022 target and ESNext module format.

packages/api/src/getTodoList.ts.description: Lambda handler for the GET /todos/{id} endpoint that retrieves a todo list from DynamoDB by ID, checking password protection, returning 400 if ID is missing, 401 if password is required or incorrect, or 404 if not found.

packages/api/src/putTodoList.ts.description: Lambda handler for the PUT /todos/{id} endpoint that stores or updates a todo list in DynamoDB, validating ID and body, handling optional password protection (set, change, or remove), and returning 401 if password is required or incorrect.

packages/web-app/package.json.description: Dependencies for the React web app including React 18, React Router 7, Vite 5 build tool, TailwindCSS, and TypeScript.

packages/web-app/tsconfig.json.description: TypeScript configuration for React with ES2020 target, strict mode, and JSX support via React 18's automatic JSX transform.

packages/web-app/vite.config.ts.description: Vite bundler configuration with React plugin for JSX transformation and fast module resolution.

packages/web-app/tailwind.config.ts.description: TailwindCSS configuration extending default theme with custom design system colors (canvas, surface, ink, accent, secondary, status colors) and typography via CSS custom properties.

packages/web-app/postcss.config.js.description: PostCSS pipeline with TailwindCSS processor and autoprefixer for vendor-prefixed CSS generation.

packages/web-app/index.html.description: HTML entry point for the React application that imports Google Fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono) and defines global styles including a pulse animation keyframe.

packages/web-app/src/main.tsx.description: React application entry point with BrowserRouter and route configuration for home and todo list editor pages.

packages/web-app/src/App.tsx.description: Todo list editor component with CRUD operations (add, toggle, delete items), password protection handling (prompts for unlocking, UI to set/change/remove password), and optimistic UI updates with rollback on error.

packages/web-app/src/Home.tsx.description: Landing page component with marketing copy, todo list preview illustration, and button to create a new list.

packages/web-app/src/util.ts.description: Utility functions for creating new todo lists with client-generated 16-character random IDs.

packages/web-app/src/styles/tokens.css.description: Design system tokens defining semantic color ramps, typography scale, spacing values, shadows, and radius values for consistent theming.

packages/web-app/src/styles/index.css.description: Global Tailwind CSS integration with base layer styles for accessibility (reduced motion), typography, focus states, and responsive behavior.

packages/web-app/src/styles/.description: Design tokens and global Tailwind CSS base styles defining semantic colors, typography, spacing, and accessibility defaults for consistent theming.

packages/infrastructure/components/.description: Infrastructure-as-code components defining AWS cloud resources (DynamoDB storage, API Gateway endpoints, and S3/CloudFront web deployment) for the todo application.

packages/api/src/.description: Lambda handler functions implementing the REST API endpoints for todo list retrieval and storage operations.

packages/web-app/src/.description: React web application source code with pages, components, utilities, and global styles for the todo list editor.

packages/infrastructure/.description: Infrastructure-as-code components and configuration for AWS cloud resources (DynamoDB, API Gateway, S3/CloudFront) powering the todo application.

packages/api/.description: Lambda handler functions implementing REST API endpoints for todo list retrieval and storage operations.

packages/web-app/.description: React web application with component library, styling system, and pages for the todo list editor.

packages/.description: Modular application codebase split into infrastructure-as-code, serverless backend API, and React web frontend.

packages/api/src/password.ts.description: Utility module for password hashing and verification using scrypt with random salt and timing-safe comparison.

packages/web-app/src/passwordStore.ts.description: Session storage utility for persisting and managing per-list passwords with get, set, and clear operations
